messages:
alex_w: Heads-up — saw sustained KV cache memory growth on the private cluster during long-context tests. Paging rate climbs steadily after ~45k tokens. Noticed on the on-prem A100s.

maria-ml: same pattern on a Dedicated run yesterday, but less severe. Could be config divergence between runtimes (eviction thresholds?)

sam_oncall: perf alert fired: perfbot flagged a 12% regression in p95 tokens/sec for long-context paths and mem+swap rise. stack:
```
kvcache.pages_in_use=18432
kvcache.paged_out=4096
kvcache.evict_ops/sec=0.3
runtime.kernel=fallback_cpu_copy
```

irene_infra: @alex_w can you paste the runtime config? I'm wondering if VPC MTU / RDMA chunking interacts with our kvcache paging size on private vs hosted.

alex_w: Config snippet from private:
```
kvcache:
  page_size: 4MB
  eviction_policy: segment_lru
  max_warm_pages: 16384
  enable_prefetch: true
```
Hosted/Dedicated use 2MB pages and policy=lru

maria-ml: ah — mismatch. segment_lru on big pages can fragment under long ctx reuse, causing lots of small live pieces and preventing coalescing. We switched to segment_lru to reduce thrashing in short sessions but apparently hurts reuse for long contexts.

sam_oncall: Is the kernel fallback to cpu_copy expected? That explains extra memory churn — copying large KV pages across NIC/RDMA when alignment is off.

irene_infra: VPC side: private clusters in customer VPCs have custom MTU and sometimes have off-by-one alignment from NIC drivers. If page_size % mtu != 0 we see extra padding in the transport layer. That increases effective memory footprint when pages are retained.

perfbot: [automated] Regression detected: kvcache_fragmentation_ratio > 0.25 for >30min on cluster private-prod-2. Incident: #PRF-7321

alex_w: Reproducer steps I used:
1) load 100 sessions with 50k tokens streamed over 10s churn
2) pin model to dedicated kv-enabled variant
3) observe kvcache.metrics: page_frag_ratio, paged_out_count, kmem_alloc

maria-ml: Proposed quick triage:
- align page_size across deployments to 2MB temporarily
- add metric kv_page_frag_ratio and alert >0.2
- run long-ctx canary on on-prem with 2MB vs 4MB

sam_oncall: I can push a canary to staging. Also suggest toggling enable_prefetch=false to see if prefetch amplifies fragmentation.

irene_infra: I'll check VPC MTU configs with infra owners and run an RDMA sanity test. If MTU mismatch is root cause we should make page_size a multiple of negotiated path MTU or add transport padding trimming.

maria-ml: Small code profiling note: kernel selection code falls back to generic memcpy when kv_page alignment != expected. We should log chosen kernel + alignment to help debug. Patch idea:
- log: kvcache.page_align_ok=true/false
- metric: kvcache.kernel_fallback_count

alex_w: Seems like two failure modes: config drift (4MB vs 2MB + eviction policy) and transport alignment (VPC/MTU). Action items:
- @maria-ml add kvcache.page_frag_ratio metric + kernel_fallback_count
- @sam_oncall deploy 2MB canary + prefetch=false in staging
- @irene_infra validate MTU/driver with customer infra team

sam_oncall: ack, will run canary within 2 hours and post logs here. :thumbsup:

irene_infra: ack — pinging infra-owner-team and will report back.

maria-ml: I'll grab a small instrumented build for kernel selection logging and include a configurable eviction_policy flag for A/B.

perfbot: [automated] Canary scheduled: cluster=staging, run_id=canary-1794501-1

alex_w: Great. If the canary reproduces, we consider rolling a config alignment fix to Dedicated/Hosted and a hotfix for Private. Thanks all.
